environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). The service runs in a Docker container with host networking. The X-Internal-Auth header is expected to be set by an upstream nginx proxy, but the ELB forwards all traffic directly to port 8080 without header stripping. No additional request filtering or SQL inspection is applied at any layer.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP listener on port 443 -> instance port 8080
config.proxy: nginx on same host, but ELB health check path bypasses nginx and hits app directly
config.security_groups: inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0, inbound 8080 from VPC CIDR
